profile.headline: Forward Deployed Engineer @ Palantir
profile.summary: I am a Forward Deployed Software Engineer at Palantir with a strong passion for problem solving and continuous learning. Enjoy mastering my skills and learning new ones. Thrive in collaborative team environments and love challenging work.

positions.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
positions.description: Forward Deployed Software Engineer at Palantir. Owning end-to-end customer relations while debugging technical challenges in the Defense Industry.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: While working as a Software Engineer at Innovative Defense Technologies I gained valuable experience centered around working in air-gapped cloud environments. I lead a migration of a large tactical system from an on-prem VMWare vSphere environment into an air-gapped Azure environment while setting up the initial cloud infrastructure. I built CI/CD pipelines in Azure to support compilation of tactical system binaries and investigated various tools and protocols within the tactical system to complete the migration.
